key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline made the 80-year-old projection the spine in-frame — performed concretely and argued from Elena's own documents (8 years of letters, mentor testimony, marketability test), it bracketed the washed-out EV in one move and pre-eliminated 'wait for more certainty' before it existed (5.0/4.0 human). The non-routed v5 AI reached the same leap-with-bounded-commitment but promoted the omission>commission asymmetry to primary status only at selection and killed its delay hedge only at verification — an ordering loss the v5 AAR itself conceded. The routed run installs m024 as a first-class pass with an explicit contract (regret-at-80 performed concretely, hindsight guard — regret over decision quality not outcome, long-horizon tiebreaker on the EV wash, opportunity-cost cross-check of stay/delay), so the projection is the spine of HOW: the delay alternative is pre-eliminated by the 60-day clock inside the regret ranking, the EV is bracketed in-frame at WHY (no wash-burn, no hedge the clock kills); m039 barbell context, m011 loop scan, m003's 7 ranked failure categories (incl. durable-omission), and m007's floor/Kelly/provenance ruin screen add breadth; verdict flips to an AI narrow edge.
learning_signal: On decide/high_stakes signatures where EV is a deliberate wash and a one-shot clock binds, the long-horizon regret test must LEAD the pass, not arbitrate at selection: the frame's spine is the 80-year-old projection run before alternative generation, with an explicit hindsight-contamination guard so the failure branch stays priced-in (regret on decision quality, not outcome), an EV-bracket conclusion ('wash or decisive') so the test is named as the tiebreaker, and an opportunity-cost cross-check that makes the status-quo's cost visible in-frame. Late-promoted regret evidence is fragile — it drifts to 'stay' under unfavorable EV and manufactures certainty-chasing hedges a 60-day clock makes fatal; 'wait for more certainty' must be pre-eliminated by the calendar inside the regret ranking, not killed at verification.
suggested_improvement: Keep the m024 first-class pass contract on long-horizon commitment forks (career, business bets, relocations): (1) perform the horizon projection concretely before generation, sourced from the decider's OWN documented values (letters, journals, mentor testimony), not generic risk preference; (2) state the hindsight guard (regret over decision quality, not outcome) so failure branches are priced in, not feared out; (3) require the EV pass to conclude 'wash or decisive' and name the test as the tiebreaker on a wash; (4) pre-eliminate delay/defer alternatives on one-shot clocks by an explicit clock-kill line; (5) pair with m003 (ranked failure categories incl. durable-omission) and m007 (floor/no-ruin) on high_stakes — this converts the v5 ordering loss into an in-frame win.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style human baseline amplified the hindsight anchor on cue — the 80-year-old test ratified the $376 purchase after a 47x run as a second chance and endorsed the all-in $53K incl. margin (2.0/5.0), with base rates (70% past-winner reversal), valuation (P/E 85 vs 26), insider sales, and the ~40% margin-call ruin path excluded from the frame; its honest Step-6 self-diagnosis arrives after the endorsement. The non-routed v5 AI already won 5.0 by improvising the 2013≠2026 decision-split. The routed run makes the escape structural: the router's NEG dual-route (confident=no → m064 + m089 first-class, trap style m024 out of top-3) plus the m007 ruin screen (R3) — the hindsight-contamination guard and anchor audit (P1: the 2013 $8 buy is not a purchasable 2026 decision; family group chat is pressure, not evidence) are contracts in-frame, the margin veto is a ruin-screen conclusion (forced realized sale at the bottom, negative-Kelly at P/E 85), and the m011 loop scan exposes the miss-recurrence mechanism so the auto-invest process fix treats the real wound.
learning_signal: The 80-year-old test is an amplifier of whatever regret is currently loudest, not a purifier: fed a vivid recent miss it returns an emotionally biased, hindsight-contaminated concentrated bet exactly where sober expected value (base rates, valuation, explicit ruin path) wins. On decide/maximize signatures with a recent-miss anchor, routing must move top-1 AWAY from the trap style (NEG metric, held here: m024 out of top-3 on its own negative case), run dual passes on ambiguity, and make the ruin screen (R3) mandatory — margin/leverage must never amplify a regret-motivated position; the guard clause (regret over decision quality, not outcome; anchor decision ≠ available decision stated before any allocation math) and the recurrence-mechanism fix (auto-invest as the cheap decisive experiment) are the deliverables, not another price forecast.
suggested_improvement: Hold the m024 contract's hindsight-contamination clause on ANY signature containing a recent-miss anchor: restate the decision in its current-time form and check anchor availability ('is the regretted decision still purchasable?') before regret reasoning may set an allocation; cap emotional evidence when the anchor is unavailable and require base rates, valuation, and an explicit worst-case/ruin-path calculation on the record; hard-rule that margin may not enter a regret-motivated position without an independent base-rate justification; on ambiguous NEG signatures keep dual-route (top-2 passes + synthesis) with m007 mandatory — this holds the NEG split at >= 90% AI wins and converts the v5 improvised escape into a structural one.
